jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Augmented Development
jobs.description:
At ACT, Your Work Makes a Difference

Education has power – a power that changes lives forever. It creates opportunities that lift up individuals, their families, and sparks societal change that echoes through generations to come. From our grassroots we have fought the good fight for inclusivity in education, and we remain devoted to helping anyone who struggles to access that power. This is what matters to us and we must do better -- we’ve never been more sure of our purpose.

ACT team members are part of an organization dedicated to a mission that has never been more important: Helping people achieve education and workplace success. Advancing that mission within our organization, by helping our team members achieve education and workplace success of their own, is core to our values. ACT values a diverse workplace and is committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which every team member has an equal opportunity to grow.

We want our team members to have the well-being and confidence they need to do their best work, in an environment where both they and ACT thrive. To support this, our total rewards include company paid life insurance, medical, dental, vision, flexible health and dependent spending accounts, 401(k) retirement savings with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and so much more. You can find a comprehensive list of our benefits here.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, to help us fulfill that mission.

The Senior Software Engineer
applies advanced knowledge, skill, and expertise to software delivery. Work is both independent and collaborative in nature. This role emphasizes using AI coding tools to develop software efficiently, while owning the judgment calls AI can't make, including reviewing, testing, and correcting AI-generated work, and taking end-to-end ownership of delivery from specification through production. Beyond using AI tools well, this role is expected to actively drive how the team adopts new AI-assisted development practices by piloting new tools and techniques, and championing what actually works. This is primarily a hands-on senior engineering role within the team, with the opportunity to grow into a cross-team responsibility for advancing how the broader engineering organization uses AI-assisted development tools as the role matures.

The finalist will be hired at the salary and level commensurate with their qualifications. For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary between $110,000 and $135,000
. ACT manages salaries within this range based on relevant factors, including skills, experience, and internal equity. This position is not incentive eligible.

Location:
This is a remote position, based in the United States.

Visa:
Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship.

What You Will Be Working On

Technical Leadership & Complex Problem-Solving
Solve complex technical problems across the team's core systems, using AI-assisted approaches to move faster, including integrations with related platforms.
Contribute senior-level technical judgment to active modernization initiatives within the team, using AI tools to accelerate legacy-to-modern platform migrations.

AI Tooling Strategy & Adoption
Pilot new AI-assisted development tools, models, and techniques within the team (e.g., new agentic coding workflows, MCP integrations, updated model versions), evaluating them against real delivery work rather than vendor claims.
Propose and champion new use cases for AI in the team's engineering practice, backed by a measured before/after comparison — time saved, defect rate, or review burden.
Feed adoption learnings back into team practice, updating norms, playbooks, or tooling recommendations as new approaches prove out (or don't).

Deep Domain Knowledge
Apply deep familiarity with the team's platform architecture, history, and constraints to guide technical decisions, including where AI-assisted approaches can speed modernization work.

AI-Directed Development & Delivery Ownership
Direct AI coding tools and agents to implement features from specs, tickets, or requirements, and own end-to-end delivery of the feature from specification through production.
Review, test, and correct AI-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit; catch both subtle errors (a plausible-but-wrong calculation, an approach that won't scale) and obvious ones.
Act as a steward against AI-specific security and supply-chain risk, scrutinizing AI-suggested dependencies, flagging unfamiliar or unverified packages before they're accepted, and treating AI-generated code that touches auth, data access, or external integrations with elevated review.
Write specs detailed enough for an AI tool to implement correctly on the first or second pass; for ambiguous problems, exercise judgment on whether to escalate or proceed independently.
Maintain and extend the team's eval and guardrail practices that catch AI-introduced regressions before they reach production.

Analysis, Recommendations & Autonomy
Independently evaluate where AI-assisted development tools, primarily Claude Code, alongside comparable tools as needed, add genuine value, for example, scaffolding and legacy code comprehension, while applying extra human scrutiny to auth-adjacent or compliance-sensitive logic.
Recommend and refine engineering practices with a high degree of autonomy, guided by high-level direction and using independent judgment to accomplish goals.

Acts as a Resource for Colleagues
Proactively share and teach AI-assisted development practices with the team (code review norms, prompt approaches, and verification habits for AI-generated output)with the opportunity to extend this to other engineering teams as the role grows.
Operate as an individual-contributor role, building credibility and driving adoption of good practice through technical expertise and collaboration.

Program & Initiative Leadership (Growth Path)
As the role matures, lead or contribute to a cross-team initiative establishing shared, practical standards for responsible AI tool usage in engineering, including guidance on what's safe to share with external AI tools, and when AI-generated code warrants elevated review.
Participate in the engineering support rotation per the team's standard model.

Role Progression

The following outlines key milestones and expectations for the first year in this role.

3-Month Mark

Completed onboarding on the team's platform architecture and AI tooling conventions; has shipped a few small features or fixes through AI-directed development, with work reviewed and merged at the team's normal quality bar.
Is closely working with other team members to understand production issues and system configurations, and has demonstrated at least one concrete instance of catching an AI-generated error or gap before it shipped.

6-Month Mark

Owns a feature or workstream end-to-end — writing the spec, directing AI-assisted implementation, and handling review and testing — with minimal day-to-day oversight from the lead.
Has contributed a concrete improvement to the team's AI-assisted development practice (a new guardrail, a refined spec template, a prompt pattern) that at least one other engineer has adopted.
Demonstrates a working understanding of the end-to-end architecture of the platforms they support, including how those platforms integrate with other systems across the broader technology ecosystem, and the underlying infrastructure architecture beneath them.

12-Month Mark

Has led a modernization effort or comparable initiative to completion, with AI-directed development visibly accelerating delivery versus a traditional approach.
Is beginning to extend influence beyond the team, if the opportunity has arisen — through early contributions to the cross-team AI standards initiative, informal mentoring, or a guardrail others have started using.

This could be the job for you if you have (minimum requirements):

Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible software engineering experience.
Engineering Fundamentals
Object-oriented and/or functional programming fundamentals.
Data modeling and query performance reasoning, across relational and/or schema-driven data layers.
API design fundamentals: contracts, versioning, and backward compatibility, whether REST or schema-first (e.g., GraphQL).
Security fundamentals: authentication/authorization flows, common injection classes, and dependency risk.
Distributed systems fundamentals: failure modes, statelessness, and behavior under concurrent load.

Representative Technologies
A backend language/runtime, such as Node.js (NestJS), Java, or a comparable OOP/functional stack.
An API paradigm, such as GraphQL or REST, including schema design and versioning.
A modern frontend framework, such as React or a comparable component-based framework.
A relational database, such as PostgreSQL, or a comparable RDBMS.
Cloud/container infrastructure, such as AWS and Kubernetes, or comparable cloud-native infrastructure.
Claude Code, or a comparable AI-assisted coding tool, used in production.

Demonstrated, hands-on production use of Claude Code or a comparable AI-assisted coding tool — candidates should be able to describe specific instances where these tools materially changed their approach to a problem.
Track record of piloting a new AI-assisted development tool or technique and measuring its actual impact (time saved, defect rate change, or review burden) rather than just using it because it's available.
Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code before accepting it, with a specific example of catching an AI-generated error before it shipped.
Working knowledge of AI-specific security risk, e.g., unverified or malicious dependencies suggested by AI tools, injected logic in auto-accepted code; and habits for catching it before it reaches production.
Strong engineering fundamentals (programming, data modeling, API design, security, and distributed systems) that hold up independent of AI tooling; treats AI tools as an amplifier of skill.
Demonstrated ability to work from ambiguous specs, with sound judgment for when to escalate and when to proceed independently.
Experience working (or ability to work) across a mixed legacy and modern technology stack.
Experience owning delivery end to end, from specification through production, including writing specs clear enough for an AI tool to implement correctly.
Bachelor's degree in computer or data science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired.

It’s a Plus If You Have

Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices and colleagues outside of a direct reporting relationship, or interest in growing into this scope.
Experience evaluating or comparing multiple AI coding tools or models for team fit.
Familiarity with test administration or assessment delivery systems, or a comparable domain is valued as a plus alongside strong engineering fundamentals and AI-directed development skill.
Experience mentoring or setting technical standards across multiple teams.
Background in education technology or a similarly regulated, integration-heavy domain.
Experience building or extending eval or guardrail frameworks for AI-generated code.

About ACT

When ACT was founded in 1959, it disrupted the assessment industry with a new approach to helping students better understand their readiness so they could take steps to improve it. By leveraging our expertise and authority in assessment and research, we will again disrupt the industry—helping more people learn, better measure their progress, and improve their navigation through life’s transitions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description:
About Clark

Every audit answers one question: can I trust this? For 150 years, people have answered it by hand. Clark is changing that.

We build AI that doesn’t just assist auditors. It does the audit work itself. More than 35 CPA firms already use Clark to run audit fieldwork faster and at equal or better quality. Audit is where we start. Our mission is to build the trust infrastructure layer for the AI economy, and we’re only getting started.

We’re a small, hard-working team backed by top investors. We take ownership and judge ourselves by results. If you want to change how an entire profession works, you’ll fit in here.

The Role

We are hiring Senior Engineers to grow the Ava team and build the AI systems that power Clark's core product.

You will design and ship production AI systems that automate complex audit and accounting workflows. This includes LLM-powered agents, retrieval systems, document intelligence, evaluations, validation, and the infrastructure required to make AI reliable in high-trust environments.

You will work closely with product engineers, Audit Engineers, customers, and company leadership to identify high-value workflows and build systems that can perform them accurately, securely, and at scale.

Why This Role Matters

Clark's ability to win and retain customers depends on the depth, reliability, and quality of Ava.

As customers ask Clark to automate more complex workflows, the Ava team must build AI systems that are both impressive in demos and reliable in production.

This role directly expands what the business can sell, deploy, and support.

What You'll Do

Build and improve LLM-powered workflows within Ava
Design agentic systems for audit and accounting workflows
Improve retrieval, reasoning, evaluation, and reliability of AI outputs
Partner with Audit Engineers to understand real customer workflows
Create evaluations, monitoring, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review systems
Build production systems that can operate in trust-sensitive environments
Improve prompt, tool-use, orchestration, and evaluation systems
Improve the accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost of production AI workflows
Collaborate with platform engineers on reliability and observability
Debug AI failure modes and improve system performance over time
Ship product features that directly impact customer adoption
Debug failures in live customer workflows and improve system performance over time
Help establish Clark’s technical standards for building safe and dependable AI systems

Who You Are

5+ years of software engineering experience
Experience building production software systems
Strong backend or full-stack engineering fundamentals
Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, or other modern AI models
Experience designing evaluations and improving AI-system performance using real production data
Comfortable working with probabilistic systems and designing around uncertainty and failure
Strong product judgment and an ability to identify the simplest system that delivers meaningful customer value
Comfortable working directly with domain experts and translating complex workflows into software
High ownership, strong communication, and excellent technical judgment
Excited to operate in person with a fast-moving, talent-dense team

Bonus

Experience building production LLM applications
Experience with agent frameworks, evals, retrieval systems, or tool-calling
Experience in fintech, compliance, accounting, audit, legaltech, or other trust-sensitive software
Experience with document-heavy workflows
Experience at a fast-moving startup

The Environment

5 days a week on-site in NYC — no remote or hybrid
Startup hours and pace — this isn't a 9-to-5
Flat structure, no hierarchy — everyone ships
High ownership — you own outcomes, not just tasks

Benefits

Unlimited PTO
Wellhub Platinum membership
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
Free company dinner every day

Compensation Range: $140K - $180K

Having built one of the most respected proprietary trading businesses in the world, it is now creating a dedicated AI group and expanding the central team behind it. The firm processes petabytes of market data every day across derivatives, equities, ETFs, bonds and currencies, giving researchers a uniquely demanding environment to test what modern AI can do. Senior AI leadership has been brought in from frontier labs, and the group is still small enough that early hires will help decide what it builds. jobs.description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As Our Business Continues To Expand, There Is Growing Demand For More Data Science Team Members. We Are Hiring 2-3 People To Drive Impact In These Areas

Growth Marketing
Product Development
AI & Automation
Strategic Partnerships

On leveling:
You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
No corporate fluff: The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Solutions ArchitectABOUT MINERVA

Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end-to-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting.

Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis.

We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge.

How We Deploy

Every enterprise account moves from a data test to a pilot to production. The technical win usually decides the deal.
Each account has a team. The account executive owns the deal. A forward deployed marketer owns the pilot's outcome. A solutions architect runs the technical evaluation and standard onboarding. A forward deployed engineer takes the accounts that need custom work.

THE ROLE

Every deal reaches the moment when the buyer's data team asks how it actually works. Every new customer reaches the moment their data has to land in Minerva and come out scored. Today our founders and data leads handle both, and they sit on the critical path of every deal.

You take both moments. You run the demo and the technical evaluation, then you run the onboarding: data in, scoring live, the customer's team trained on the platform. Most of our enterprise customers come through you. The few that need custom pipelines or models go to our forward deployed engineers, and you know when to hand one off.

What You'll Do

Run demos and technical evaluations, often on the buyer's own data: discovery with their data team, how the data moves (warehouse shares, flat files, API) and a match test on their sample.
Run enterprise onboarding. Ingest first-party data, run routine scoring and get the customer's team live in our admin dashboard. Think of a pro sports team, from first file to first scored audience.
Build the simple pipelines and transformations onboarding needs, in SQL and light Python.
Carry the technical side of security reviews with our compliance lead, so questionnaires don't stall deals.
Write the playbook. Standard onboarding steps, reference setups and demo environments, so the next SA ramps in weeks.
Bring back what buyers asked for that we couldn't show, and tell product which gaps cost deals.

WHAT YOU HAVE

3+ years in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, customer data onboarding or technical consulting, ideally at a martech, adtech, CDP, identity or analytics company, or an agency's data team.
Strong SQL. You've worked hands-on with customer data and the platforms it lives in.
You've run a demo for a skeptical data team and an onboarding for an enterprise customer, and both went well.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Calibration & Optimization
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

Calibration is fundamental to the accuracy, stability and productivity of semiconductor inspection and metrology systems. KLA is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to rethink how electron-optical systems are calibrated and recalibrated—using machine learning, mathematical and statistical modeling, physics-informed AI and large-scale engineering data. You will develop next-generation calibration solutions that reduce calibration time, improve accuracy and repeatability, compensate for drift, strengthen tool-to-tool matching, and enable more intelligent diagnostics and recovery. This role combines advanced modeling with real experimental systems: you will develop algorithms, validate them against hardware data and work with engineering teams to integrate successful solutions into products. The underlying mission and scope come directly from the team’s need to modernize calibration, diagnostics and optimization across electron sources, electron-optical columns, steering systems, detectors, alignment, focus, high-voltage, and vacuum-related performance.

What You Will Do

Redesign calibration and recalibration workflows to improve speed, accuracy, repeatability, robustness, and system productivity.
Develop and validate calibration algorithms for electron sources, electron-optical columns, deflectors and beam-steering systems, detectors, alignment and focus functions, and performance compensation associated with high-voltage and vacuum behavior.
Apply machine learning, statistical modeling and physics-informed AI to predict calibration outcomes, model system behavior, and improve calibration decisions.
Build methods to detect drift, anomalies and performance excursions using engineering, operational and fleet-level data.
Optimize calibration sequences to reduce time, eliminate unnecessary steps, and balance accuracy, throughput, and system risk.
Develop adaptive and self-correcting approaches that respond to changing system conditions and support more autonomous calibration behavior.
Create intelligent diagnostic and recovery methods that accelerate root-cause identification and restore system performance after calibration or hardware excursions.
Build and combine physics-based and data-driven models, including correlation models, response models, sensitivity studies, uncertainty estimates and error-propagation analyses.
Analyze large, heterogeneous engineering datasets to identify performance patterns, tool-to-tool differences, failure modes, and opportunities for improvement.
Design and execute experiments to evaluate calibration repeatability, reproducibility, robustness, and generalization across operating conditions.
Correlate model predictions with experimental measurements and use discrepancies to refine models, algorithms, and calibration strategies.
Partner with electron optics, systems, software, algorithm, manufacturing, and service teams to translate system requirements into deployable calibration and monitoring solutions.
Support the full path from concept through algorithm implementation, experimental validation, product qualification, and production deployment.
Continuously evaluate advances in scientific machine learning, optimization, anomaly detection, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, and intelligent control.

Required Qualifications

M.S. or Ph.D. in Physics, Applied Physics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Optical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Three or more years of relevant industrial or applied research experience. Relevant doctoral or postdoctoral work may qualify when it demonstrates substantial ownership of applied modeling, algorithm development, experimentation or engineering-data analysis.
Demonstrated experience developing and validating machine-learning, statistical or mathematical models for complex physical, scientific or engineering problems.
Strong foundation in several of the following:

Numerical optimization
Probability and statistics
Linear algebra and numerical methods
Regression, estimation, or system identification
Time-series or multivariate analysis
Sensitivity analysis, uncertainty quantification, or error propagation
Proficiency in Python and practical experience with a modern ML or scientific-computing framework such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn, SciPy or a comparable environment.
Experience working with substantial engineering, experimental, simulation, sensor, telemetry, or operational datasets.
Evidence of personally developing or materially improving an algorithm, model, or optimization method—not solely applying an off-the-shelf model.
Experience designing experiments, evaluating model performance, and correlating analytical or model predictions with measured results.
Ability to independently frame ambiguous technical problems, test hypotheses, evaluate tradeoffs and communicate conclusions to cross-functional engineering partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with calibration, system identification, controls, diagnostics, drift compensation, predictive maintenance or condition monitoring.
Familiarity with electron-optical systems, SEM, charged-particle optics, semiconductor inspection or metrology equipment.
Experience with advanced scientific instruments, imaging systems, robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace systems, medical imaging, industrial equipment or other sensor-rich physical platforms.
Experience with fleet data, machine telemetry, high-dimensional time-series data or distributed engineering-data environments.
Familiarity with physics-informed neural networks, neural operators, surrogate models, differentiable simulation, inverse problems or hybrid physics/data models.
Experience with design of experiments, statistical process control, robust optimization, Bayesian methods or uncertainty-aware modeling.
Experience accelerating scientific workloads with GPUs, HPC or parallel computing.
Experience translating Python or research prototypes into production software; C++ experience is helpful but not required.
Experience contributing algorithms to a released product or operational engineering workflow.

Minimum Qualifications

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

See yourself at Dataminr

As a Senior Research Scientist at Dataminr, you will tackle some of the toughest AI problems in real time threat and risk intelligence, advancing the state of the art in large language models, generative AI, and agentic systems while seeing your work go straight into products. You will train and adapt LLMs, build multimodal and agentic systems that reason over live global data, and develop innovative solutions that surface the insights that matter most. You will do it alongside a collaborative team that cares about meaningful work. This is a hybrid role based in our New York City or Arlington, VA office.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI:
our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI:
we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI:
our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

Build and deploy AI models that decide within seconds whether a burst of posts across 150 languages signals a real event, and push the state of the art in real time AI on live global data at massive scale.
Advance multimodal and LLM research by creating systems that can verify a video from an unfolding crisis and agents that keep a brief accurate as facts change minute by minute.
Take your research from experiment to production, shipping models into Dataminr products used by organizations around the world.
See your work shape how teams everywhere respond to critical events as they unfold, where rigor, speed, and good judgment all matter.
Partner with a diverse, interdisciplinary group of engineers, product experts, and domain specialists to deliver value for existing and new customers.
Share your work with the wider community through publications in top tier venues, program committee service, and AI for Good collaborations with nonprofit organizations.

What You Bring

At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field, with real depth in one or more areas such as LLM training and adaptation, distillation, evaluation and benchmarking, agentic systems, retrieval and grounding, search, recommendation, multimodal models, or temporal and streaming reasoning.
Track record of research that others build on, shown through publications at venues like NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, AAAI, COLM, or CVPR.
Hands-on experience training and adapting models at scale, backed by strong Python and PyTorch fundamentals.
Comfort with modern training and inference tooling such as vLLM and Langfuse, so you can move from idea to a working system quickly.
Independence to design experiments, chart your own path, and show progress through principled, well-chosen metrics.
Fluency with AI coding and research agents, and a habit of using them to speed up your own work.
Ability to own research projects from first idea to shipped result, and to bring teammates along as you go.
Leadership streak that shows up as cross-functional technical guidance and mentorship, helping other scientists grow and do their best work.

About Dataminr

At Dataminr, we are a mission driven team of talented builders, creators and visionaries who have real-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Dataminr’s groundbreaking, AI-powered, intelligence platform provides organizations with the earliest signals of emerging risks, events, and threats before they unfold. Trusted by two-thirds of the Fortune 50 and half of the Fortune 100, Dataminr’s platform analyzes billions of public data inputs spanning text, image, video, audio and sensor data across 150+ languages, empowering our clients to stay one step ahead in an increasingly complex world where every second counts.

Founded in 2009, we have pioneered the world’s first real-time event detection platform, long before the recent Gen AI ‘boom.’ Dataminr operates all around the world united by our passion to use AI for the greater good, be agents of positive change and put our technology into the hands of clients charged with the responsibility to keep organizations running and keep people safe.

As our employees focus on developing our revolutionary technology, we focus on our employees. Dataminr is proud to offer a variety of flexible work arrangements, offices all over the world to foster collaboration, generous PTO and sick leave, and more, as part of our competitive benefits package aimed at keeping all our employees happy and healthy. Explore all our benefits here
.

We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, manager development programming, professional development funds, and more.

We serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the world and clients we serve, with a workforce built on merit and equity. jobs.description:
About Taskrabbit:
Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.
At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.
Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!
Prior to applying please note:

W

e are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position (including H-1B, OPT, F1, CPT or other employment-based visas). Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. 

This role is hybrid requiring 2 days in office at our San Francisco or NYC hub every Tuesday & Wednesday. 

About the Role Data Science plays a crucial role in driving impact at Taskrabbit. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Staff Data Scientist to join us, working closely with cross-functional teams from Product teams and occasionally Commercial Operations to provide data-driven insights and solutions that enhance our products and accelerate growth while minimizing marketplace losses.
What you will work on Be a strategic thought partner with stakeholders in Product and occasionally Commercial Operations to define high-impact analytical problems, and solve them using different analytical and statistical approaches. Present actionable insights in a clear and compelling manner.
Proactively perform analytical deep dives to identify strategic growth opportunities in key business levers with a focus on Product
Collaborate with stakeholders to define and measure success metrics for new features and products, conduct advanced experimentation and causal inference to optimize product features and user experiences
Lead central Data Science initiatives, e.g. experimentation system, building data agents, influencing eventing systems, etc.
Foster a data-driven culture within the organization by advocating for best practices in data analysis and interpretation.

Who you are BS, MS or Ph.D. in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research, or related field).
A minimum of 7 years industry experience in data science
Strong and relevant experience with advanced experimentation and statistical modeling
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent business acumen and strategic thinking skills, especially in a commerce/risk domain
Expert in SQL, experienced in Python, and familiar with data pipeline tooling (e.g. dbt) and git. Bonus points for experience in productionizing ML models and familiarity with ML Ops.
A self-starter with the ability to work independently and drive your own projects end-to-end with a track record of landing strong business impact 
Ability to communicate complex data findings in a clear and concise manner to an executive audience.

Compensation & Benefits: 
At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks.
The base pay range for this position is $170,000 - $225,000
. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.
You’ll love working here because:
Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company.

We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.
The People.

You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!

We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.

Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Job Title: Generative AI Engineer (GenAI / LLM)

Experience: 5+ Years (Recommended; adjust based on the requirement)
Employment Type: Contract / Full-Time (As Applicable)

Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern AI engineering frameworks. The ideal candidate will have strong Python development experience, hands-on expertise in LLM integration, prompt engineering, vector databases, and scalable AI application development. The successful candidate will collaborate with data science, software engineering, cloud, and product teams to build secure, reliable, and production-ready generative AI solutions that address real-world business requirements.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to retrieve, process, and generate contextually relevant responses from enterprise data.
Integrate commercial and open-source LLMs through APIs and model-serving frameworks.
Develop prompt templates, system instructions, few-shot examples, and structured output strategies to improve model accuracy and consistency.
Build document ingestion and processing pipelines, including text extraction, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, indexing, and retrieval.
Implement semantic search and hybrid retrieval using vector databases and search technologies.
Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows to support multi-step reasoning and task execution where appropriate.
Build backend services and APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
Integrate GenAI applications with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and existing business applications.
Evaluate model responses for relevance, factual accuracy, groundedness, latency, and cost.
Implement safeguards to reduce hallucinations, prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and inappropriate model outputs.
Optimize LLM performance through prompt optimization, caching, model selection, retrieval tuning, and other appropriate techniques.
Collaborate with cloud and platform engineering teams to deploy and operate AI applications in scalable environments.
Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, evaluation pipelines, and production troubleshooting for AI systems.
Follow software engineering best practices, including version control, automated testing, code reviews, documentation, and CI/CD.
Participate in technical design discussions and translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.

Qualifications

Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Required Skills

Required Technical Skills
Generative AI and LLMs
Strong understanding of Generative AI concepts, transformer architectures, and Large Language Models.
Hands-on experience integrating LLMs such as GPT-family models, Claude, Llama, or other suitable models.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and model response evaluation.
Understanding of tokenization, context windows, embeddings, temperature, and model inference parameters.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
Knowledge of document parsing, chunking strategies, embedding models, retrieval, reranking, and context construction.
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Chroma, or FAISS.
Understanding of semantic search, metadata filtering, hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.
Programming and Application Development
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience developing REST APIs and backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent frameworks.
Familiarity with asynchronous programming, data processing, exception handling, testing, and debugging.
Experience integrating external APIs, databases, and enterprise application services.
AI Frameworks and Libraries
Experience with one or more frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent GenAI development libraries.
Familiarity with embedding models, model orchestration, tool calling, and AI workflow development.
Knowledge of agent frameworks and multi-step AI workflows is an advantage.
Data and Databases
Experience working with SQL and structured or unstructured data.
Understanding of document processing, data preparation, metadata management, and indexing.
Experience with relational databases and at least one vector database or search platform.
Cloud, Deployment, and Operations
Experience deploying applications in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and production deployment practices.
Understanding of scalability, availability, security, latency, and cost optimization for AI applications.
Knowledge of MLOps or LLMOps practices is preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to convert business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Effective collaboration with engineering, data, security, and product teams.
Strong communication, documentation, and technical decision-making skills.
Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, data, retrieval, and model layers.

Preferred Skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience building production-grade GenAI applications used by business teams or external customers.
Familiarity with fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, or model adaptation.
Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLMs and RAG systems.
Understanding of guardrails, responsible AI, model governance, and data privacy.
Experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, and distributed application architectures.
Knowledge of observability tools and automated quality testing for AI workflows.
Experience in enterprise environments involving sensitive or regulated data.

Pay range and compensation package

Expected Outcomes

Deliver reliable and maintainable GenAI applications aligned with business requirements.
Improve response quality through effective retrieval, prompt design, and evaluation.
Build secure and scalable AI services suitable for production workloads.
Reduce unnecessary model calls and optimize application latency and operating costs.

jobs.description:
Seekr is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of enterprise AI. As a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the platforms that enable large-scale training, serving, evaluation, and deployment of foundation models and autonomous AI agents.

You will work across distributed systems, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, high-performance inference, and enterprise AI platforms to build secure, scalable, and highly reliable systems capable of serving workloads ranging from edge AI deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, AI platform engineering, and production software development. You will collaborate with research scientists, software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure engineers to define the architecture and technical direction of Seekr’s AI platform.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production AI infrastructure supporting model training, fine-tuning, inference, evaluation, and agentic AI workloads.
Design and operate scalable Kubernetes-based infrastructure supporting GPU-accelerated workloads across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and edge environments.
Architect and optimize high-performance inference platforms capable of serving models ranging from resource-constrained edge deployments to trillion-parameter foundation models, with a focus on latency, throughput, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
Build and maintain distributed systems that enable reliable scheduling, orchestration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of AI workloads.
Develop enterprise platforms supporting autonomous and multi-agent AI systems, including secure tool execution, orchestration, memory, evaluation, governance, and observability.
Design, implement, and automate AI infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering practices.
Evaluate and integrate emerging AI infrastructure technologies, model serving frameworks, hardware accelerators, and cloud-native platforms to improve platform performance, scalability, and reliability.
Collaborate with engineering, research, product, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready AI platforms.
Lead technical design discussions, perform architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and establish engineering standards and best practices across the AI Infrastructure organization.
Participate in production support activities, including troubleshooting complex distributed systems, performance tuning, incident response, and continuous operational improvement.

Skills and Qualifications

5–8 years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale platform services
Strong production ML infra experience, executes complex work independently, owns significant components
4 year or higher degree or additional relevant experience, in addition to years of work experience
Demonstrated success designing and operating production Kubernetes environments supporting cloud-native applications and distributed services.
Strong software engineering skills using Python and one or more modern programming languages such as Go, Rust, or C++.
Proven ability to design, build, and operate production AI or machine learning infrastructure.
Expertise developing and optimizing large-scale AI inference platforms, including GPU utilization, distributed inference, batching, caching, quantization, and accelerator performance.
Familiarity with modern AI serving technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of distributed computing, networking, storage systems, cloud-native architectures, and infrastructure automation using technologies such as Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
Experience developing enterprise AI platforms, autonomous agents, or multi-agent systems, including orchestration, tool execution, governance, observability, and evaluation.
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, distributed messaging systems, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Demonstrated technical leadership, including driving architectural decisions, mentoring engineers, and leading complex technical initiatives across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, profile, and optimize AI systems for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost across distributed compute environments.

This range reflects Seekr’s good faith estimate of what it expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. About the Company:

Seekr is a leader in explainable and trustworthy artificial intelligence designed to power mission-critical decisions in enterprises, government, and regulated industries. SeekrFlow™, our end-to-end AI platform, provides secure, auditable AI solutions tailored to sectors where transparency, accuracy, and compliance are paramount. Available across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments, SeekrFlow reduces bias, strengthens data integrity, and simplifies model oversight so organizations can rely on trusted AI decisions in high-stakes settings that impact society’s most sensitive and vital systems. Trusted by leading enterprises and government agencies, we partner with defense, finance, telecom, and critical infrastructure leaders to enable AI solutions that drive real-world results with unmatched transparency and control. We are a team of strategic thinkers and problem-solvers tackling the toughest challenges facing critical infrastructure and global enterprises through best-in-class AI models and customer deployment. We are driven by outcomes—our customers' success is what we strive for every day.
We believe trust is earned, which is why we build explainability and transparency into the entire AI lifecycle.
We take our responsibility to deliver secure AI seriously.

At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.

Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

About the Role

The Solution Architect, Legal Billing is a member of Litify Professional Services who leads the time, billing, and financial side of client implementations. You bring a formal accounting background and software implementation skills to design and deliver time entry, expense tracking, billing, and collections workflows for law firms on the Litify platform. You work directly with firm billing teams, finance staff, and partners. You learn how they capture time and costs and turn them into paid invoices today, then translate that into a sound Litify design and own it through go-live.

You will:

Lead discovery with firm billing and finance teams to map how they capture time and expenses, review pre-bills, issue invoices, and collect payment.
Design billing setups on Litify and Salesforce: timekeeper and client-matter rates, rate hierarchies and overrides, fee arrangements (hourly, flat fee, contingency, and hybrid), and invoice templates.
Configure time and expense capture, including activity and task codes, hard and soft costs, cost recovery, and markups.
Build pre-bill review and approval workflows, including write-ups, write-downs, and billing adjustments.
Set up e-billing for clients that require it, including LEDES file formats, UTBMS codes, and outside counsel billing guidelines.
Design AR and collections processes, including payments, retainers, applying trust funds to invoices, and client statements.
Deliver billing and financial reporting: WIP, realization, timekeeper utilization, aged AR, and collections.
Plan and support migration of open WIP, unbilled costs, and AR balances from legacy billing systems, with reconciliation to the source.
Configure and test the solution, working with Litify developers and other Solution Architects where custom build is needed.
Run workshops, UAT, training, and go-live support with client billing, finance, and operations staff.
Keep project status, risks, and documentation current.
Feed field learnings back to Product and Professional Services to improve the billing offering.

You have (required):

Listed in priority order.

Bachelor’s degree
in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA license or CPA-eligible status preferred
Legal billing experience:
3+ years of hands-on work in law firm billing or finance, or at a legal time and billing software company, with working knowledge of all of the following: time and expense entry, rate management, fee arrangements, pre-bill review and adjustments, invoicing, LEDES and UTBMS e-billing, client billing guidelines, AR and collections, WIP and realization reporting, and trust accounting basics.
Software implementation and technical experience:
3+ years implementing or consulting on time, billing, or financial software. Covers discovery, requirements, configuration, data migration of WIP, unbilled time and costs, and AR, UAT, and go-live. Comfortable with SQL or ETL tools for loading and validating financial data, and with how systems integrate.
Client delivery:
runs workshops with firm billing teams, finance staff, and partners, presents clearly to executives, and manages several projects at once.

You have (nice-to-have):

Salesforce experience:
implementation or admin work on Salesforce; Salesforce Administrator certification.
Accounting Seed or Certinia (formerly FinancialForce): a major plus.
Hands-on implementation of a Salesforce-native accounting or billing product.
Experience implementing or supporting legal time and billing systems such as Elite 3E, Aderant, Centerbase, or Juris.
Experience with e-billing platforms such as Legal Tracker, TyMetrix 360, or BillBlast.
Experience with Litify or another legal practice management platform.

Disclosure:

This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey. Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month.

The estimated base salary for this role is $130-145k. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Lumen Solutions Group Inc. is a technology consulting Services company based in Florida. We provide a wide array of experienced business and IT professionals supporting clients from solution design to implementation and support. We specialize in professional IT consulting services, IT Staffing, Business/IT Strategy, Business Process Blueprints, Enterprise Architecture, and Enterprise Transformation.

Job Title: Senior Solution Architect - Corporate Security Subject Matter Expert

Location:
Remote/Washington DC.

Duration:
12+ Months Contract

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Solution Architect to serve as the technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for physical and electronic security systems engineering and design compliance. The ideal candidate will review complex security-system designs, validate compliance with organizational standards and operational requirements, identify technical risks, and provide expert guidance throughout all phases of security projects.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the primary technical SME for electronic security systems engineering, architecture, and design compliance.
Review and evaluate security-system designs, engineering drawings, technical specifications, and construction documents.
Identify design deficiencies, technical risks, compliance gaps, and areas requiring clarification or revision.
Validate security designs against organizational standards, operational requirements, and industry best practices.
Provide technical recommendations and design guidance to internal stakeholders, architects, engineers, consultants, and contractors.
Support all phases of physical and electronic security initiatives, from planning and design through implementation and acceptance.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to resolve technical issues and ensure effective security-system integration.
Maintain consistency, quality, and compliance across enterprise physical and electronic security projects.
Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Required Skills

Extensive experience in electronic security systems engineering, solution architecture, or security-system design.
Strong knowledge of physical and electronic security systems within complex facilities or enterprise environments.
Proven experience reviewing engineering designs, technical plans, specifications, and construction-related security documents.
Expertise in design compliance, technical risk assessment, operational requirements, and security engineering best practices.
Ability to identify design deficiencies, technical inconsistencies, and compliance issues and recommend corrective actions.
Experience collaborating with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and security or business stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills.
Ability to serve as a trusted technical SME and provide independent technical direction.

Preferred Skills

Experience supporting physical security programs within transportation, infrastructure, government, or other regulated environments.
Knowledge of electronic security engineering standards, design principles, and industry best practices.
Experience supporting the full project lifecycle, including planning, design review, implementation, testing, and acceptance.
Background reviewing multidisciplinary architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) designs.
Experience supporting enterprise-scale physical security and electronic security system initiatives.
Ability to coordinate technical reviews and ensure consistent security-system design quality across multiple projects.

Founded by leading robotics researchers, we are growing our dynamic, world-class team to deploy robots at scale. Join us in helping people handle more throughout the supply chain!

We are seeking a Senior Robotics Research Engineer to design and develop fundamental new contributions to core robotics libraries and runtime application software for Ambi products, focused on new technology for the future. You will work closely with the Software team and the CTO.

In this role you will:

Independently develop robot applications and capabilities (controls, planning, perception)
Lead R&D projects for new AI-driven robot skills, powered by foundation models
Contribute to AmbiOS core libraries in areas such as: (a) scalable AI training, algorithms, models, and evaluation, (b) perception modules, (c) image and point cloud processing, (d) motion planning policies, (e) collision checkers
Support software deployments to AI-powered robotic systems in production with global brands
Modify existing software and configurations for new customers

You are a good fit if you have:

Eagerness to learn, solve challenging problems, and lead with curiosity
A desire for career growth, ownership of your work, and making an impact
Excitement about amplifying human potential with state-of-the-art robotics
Proficiency in C++, Python, Linux, Git, and, Docker
Expertise in motion planning, contact physics, machine learning, and computer vision
Experience in the following areas: robotics (3D rigid geometry, kinematics, motion planning), software architecture, state machines, multi-processing, operating systems (must know UNIX), drivers (cameras, sensors, other equipment), and software update systems
An MS with four years of experience in commercial robotics software development or equivalent or PhD in a very related subject
(BONUS) Experience in Rust

In addition to competitive compensation, we offer benefits such as:

Health, dental, and vision insurance
401k with 5% matching by Ambi
Equity ownership
Unlimited PTO
Partial WFH
Free parking on site at HQ
Access to a full gym at HQ
Free lunches 2x per week

All applications must be submitted online for equitable review. We do not accept or review submissions sent via email, including to individual team members or engineers. This policy ensures a fair and streamlined process for everyone.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

Develop agentic workflows, AI-assisted applications, tool integrations, retrieval patterns, and deterministic automation for security use cases.
Define agent boundaries, identity, permissions, approved tools, human approval points, auditability, rollback, and emergency-stop behavior.
Build reusable services and components using Python, APIs, Git-based CI/CD, containers, and enterprise automation platforms.

Implement telemetry for agent decisions, tool calls, failures, quality, security events, and operational health.
Partner with security engineering, architecture, governance, platform, and operations teams to move validated prototypes into supported capabilities.
Document architecture, controls, runbooks, test evidence, ownership, and support models.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Complies with all policies and standards.

A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science) and Requires 4 – 6 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Technical Skills

Senior-level experience building production software, security automation, platform engineering, or AI-enabled systems.
Direct experience with agentic AI is strongly preferred, but demonstrated depth in software engineering plus applied AI/LLM development may substitute.
Experience with AWS, Bedrocks, and Databrisks preferred.

Design, develop, and maintain backend APIs using Python 3.12+ and FastAPI.

new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join Snap Inc!

What you’ll do:

Build and deploy machine learning models that power core products, serving millions of Snapchatters
Apply modern ML techniques to solve large-scale, real-world problems
Own the full ML lifecycle from data analysis to production deployment
Partner with cross-functional teams to prototype and launch ML-driven features
Utilize AI tools to design and ship scalable services while upholding rigorous standards for code correctness, security, and production

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Strong understanding of machine learning approaches and algorithms
Able to prioritize duties and work well on your own
Ability to work with both internal and external partners
Skilled at solving open ambiguous problems
Strong collaboration and mentorship skills
Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks
Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science or equivalent years of practical work experience
5+ years of post-Bachelor’s machine learning experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 4+ year of post-grad machine learning experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field + 1 years of post-grad machine learning experience
Experience developing machine learning models for ranking, recommendations, search, content understanding, image generation, or other relevant applications of machine learning

Preferred Qualifications:

Advanced degree in computer science or related field
Experience working with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Caffe2, PyTorch, Spark ML, scikit-learn, or related frameworks
Experience working with machine learning, ranking infrastructures, and system design

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

new_jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer (Remote Eligible)
new_jobs.description:
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand-in-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact.

What You’ll Do:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
